editPage.roleHint: sets the icon, injects its default directives (shown in Injections) and suggests a model and a permission mode
editPage.workingDirectoryHint: the folder its tools work in
editPage.projectHint: groups agents across the interface; derived from the working directory, but you can change it
editPage.noProject: No project: this agent is not grouped
editPage.projectTasksHint: who runs each kind of task on this agent's project — by role, not by name
editPage.projectTasksNoProject: This agent has no project: no task is sent to it.

projectTaskSource.convention: nobody holds this role: an agent will be created on the first task

editPage.projectTasksFooter: Give this agent the matching role and it is picked up automatically, whatever its name. Pin only to settle a tie between two agents of the same role.
editPage.globalContextHint: Adds your most active projects and your objectives to the system prompt at launch. Turn it on for the main agent and for standalone agents that weigh priorities across projects.
editPage.skillsEmpty: No skills installed yet. Create some from
editPage.docNameInvalid: A doc name holds only letters, digits, dots, underscores and dashes, and ends in .md.
editPage.saveWarningsToast: {name} saved, with {count, plural, one {a warning} other {# warnings}} about its permissions
editPage.computerUseToggle: Let this agent control the computer
editPage.computerUseHint: Gives the agent a screenshot of your main screen and control of the mouse and keyboard, through the Timon desktop app. Off by default.
editPage.computerUseWarning: Warning: the agent really moves your mouse and types on your keyboard, in whatever is open on your screen. Watch it work, never leave it with sensitive windows open, and know that you can stop it at any time. It never types a password for you.
editPage.computerUseMac: macOS: in the system settings, under Privacy and Security, allow Timon for Accessibility and for Screen Recording.
editPage.computerUseLinux: Linux: an X11 session with xdotool installed. Wayland is not supported.
editPage.computerUseNeedsDesktop: Only works while the Timon desktop app is running on this machine.
editPage.computerModeForegroundHint: The agent sees your screen and may click and type like you do. Use it for applications that accessibility does not describe: games, canvas applications.
editPage.computerModeBackground: Background (accessibility only, never touches your screen)
editPage.computerModeBackgroundHint: The agent reads and presses elements through accessibility, window by window. It takes no screenshot and never moves your mouse, keyboard or focus, so you can keep working. Each application below can still be set on its own.
editPage.computerAppsHint: Each application has its own mode. The agent only controls the applications listed here: in the foreground when it is in front, in the background through accessibility. Use the application name, its executable name or, on macOS, its bundle identifier; case does not matter.
editPage.computerAppsEmptyWarning: Empty list = the agent cannot do anything with the computer.
editPage.computerAppsFromWindowsHint: Click an application to allow it:
editPage.computerAppsNoWindows: No window to offer. Is the Timon desktop app running on this machine?
editPage.computerAppsAllListed: Every open application is already in the list.
editPage.computerAppsModesHint: Screenshots, the mouse and the keyboard only work while the application in front is allowed in the foreground. Native applications (TextEdit, Notes, Finder, Notepad) have a rich accessibility tree and can run in the background; games and canvas applications have an empty tree and need the foreground.
editPage.computerAppsVerdictUnchecked: Not checked: open the application and add it from the open windows to check it
editPage.computerAllAppsOff: Off: only the allowed applications below
editPage.computerAllAppsOn: On: every application except the excluded ones
editPage.computerAllAppsExcludedDefault: Default list: {count, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}}
editPage.computerAllAppsExcludedDescription: Never controlled, even when they are in the allowed list.
